references.text: Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded them by going to Pharaoh, as described in this verse.
The Israelites did exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron; the same formula of obedience is used.
All the Israelites did just as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron, an identical expression of obedience.
The Israelites completed the tabernacle just as the Lord had commanded Moses, following the same pattern of obedience.
Moses did in all things just as the Lord had commanded him, showing the same obedience as in 7:6.
Moses did as the Lord had commanded him regarding Joshua, using the same formula of obedience.
Joshua was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him, as the Lord had commanded.
Abraham obeyed when he was called, serving as an example of faith's obedience like that of Moses and Aaron.
